name: DriveCombo
description: DriveCombo is a text and vision-based benchmark designed to evaluate compositional traffic rule reasoning in autonomous driving systems. It assesses model capabilities across a Five-Level Cognitive Ladder from single-rule understanding to multi-rule integration and conflict resolution, enabling quantitative evaluation of complex real-world traffic scenarios.
reputation: A very recent benchmark that is not yet widely established, but it targets an important and underexplored capability in autonomous driving reasoning.
notes: Includes a Rule2Scene Agent for mapping language-based traffic rules to dynamic driving scenes; highlights performance drops in rule conflict scenarios.
